review_notes: Independently read all owned C evidence and cited magnifier caller/construction ranges. Seven proposed changes agree with canonical behavior and functionality document; inherited retained knowledge remains unchanged. Section-layout contradictions are accepted deferrals, not compiled conclusions.
unresolved: Compiled section placement, float-pool composition, switch-table emission, sizes and padding remain unverified; the Stc_rarwmdls literal is 11 characters plus NUL.

proposed_facts.reason: The request guard excludes CPU rather than positively requiring human slots; allocation requires slot below four, clear registration and a direction-zero entry. Caller supplies normal states 1/2.
State and color are copied only on allocation, without direction validation or a NULL guard. Duplicate registration prevents refresh; initialization and release clear direction and registration.
Canonical signature uses unsigned char. Caller computes a player-array difference, narrows to u8 and operates over six entries; release has no range guard.

Release scans every owner without an active-state check or early exit. Only matching owners cause registration indexing. Static zero initialization and bounded request writes support the stated normal ownership invariant.
Initialization installs stable index pointers and callbacks, constructs four models, clears x24/x28, and preserves x2C/x14. Sound and draw-state resets match the source.
The file-level explanation correctly distinguishes player registration from pool ownership and follows request, indexed update, release, initialization and pointer-clearing teardown.
Release is a useful inferred counterpart to Request: it clears matching request state without destroying retained objects. The rendered baseline leaves this function unnamed.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all four .data facts and the .data link: the automatic centering array and its consumers establish behavior, not emitted section placement.
Accept deferral of all five .rodata facts and the .rodata link: the state switch establishes routes but not a compiled dispatch table, addresses, size or padding.

Accept deferral of all four .sdata facts. Resource lookup is supported, but storage placement and section dimensions are not. The baseline literal-length rationale is incorrect: Stc_rarwmdls contains 11 characters plus NUL; this is explicitly acknowledged rather than endorsed.

Accept deferral of all four .sdata2 facts and the .sdata2 link. Source annotates the immutable index array, but does not establish section ordering, float-pool placement, nine emitted constants or a 40-byte composition.
The two superseded request claims are corrected by proposals 0/1: CPU exclusion is not human-only eligibility, and unchecked state assignment is not unconditional activation or duplicate refresh.

The two superseded release-domain claims are corrected by proposals 2/3. The caller has six entries; release checks owner equality, not activity. Normal slots 4/5 do not imply unconditional out-of-bounds writes because bounded requests cannot install those owners.

The superseded initialization and file data-flow claims are corrected by proposals 4/5: initialization clears registration and direction, while release preserves the owner mapping. Neither operation clears owner or color.
